title: actor.heartbeat — Request
description: Record liveness for an active agent session and return the canonical actor envelope. This verb is for active agent sessions only. It refreshes liveness metadata server-side, but it updates liveness only: it MUST NOT mint or rotate credentials and MUST NOT change runtime or parent-linkage metadata.

actor_id.description: UUID of the active agent session whose liveness is being refreshed. Human actors are out of scope for this verb.
